# Purple

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public shop: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: light.

Purple is a public mattress and bedding shop. This package is a signed-out capture of [https://purple.com](https://purple.com) on 2026-11-22. The live host returned Cloudflare error 1009 for this region (SG), so the public tree was read from the 18 November 2026 archive and the photographs come from styled archive pages of the same shop. Desktop width measured 1440 by 900. Nothing was typed, submitted, or signed in.

`catalog.json` was left alone. `webapps-manifest.json` was left alone. `login-extracted` was not flipped.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Keep the page cream and the type ink.** The page and footer are `#f8f5ef`. Body and nav type are `#181831`. [screenshots/home-light-1440.png](screenshots/home-light-1440.png)
- **Use a 48px pill for the primary button.** Learn about our mattresses is 46px tall, ink fill, white type, radius `48px`. [screenshots/category-light-1440.png](screenshots/category-light-1440.png)
- **Mark a sale in promo red.** Black Friday Sale and the On sale badge are `#ca2b16`. [screenshots/category-light-1440.png](screenshots/category-light-1440.png)
- **Stop before account, cart, and the email field.** Those controls were listed and not opened or submitted. [site-tree.md](site-tree.md)
